data.subject: Local Ledger: FJ Capital coverage
data.body:
Hi,

Your fund's most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in HWBK and CBNA.

HWBK completed an acquisition or disposition of assets in an 8-K Item 2.01 filing dated September 4, 2026. (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/893847/000089384726000091/hwbk-20260903.htm)

I publish a free weekly issue based on public records and can offer a four-week fund pilot.

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
